hypothesis: V85 unshrunk external-original target means assign equal numeric confidence to singleton and well-supported source groups. Source-support uncertainty is absent from current feature mapping.
distinct_from_previous: Not synthetic TE smoothing, not the closed income original-frequency/lift/novelty append experiment; examines original-label prior reliability in V85 across retained source-mean columns.
scope: Read competition features without labels. Rebuild frozen V85 static schema with original labels only in its existing source prior mapping; compute support profile using original feature counts alone. No competition labels, AUC, or predictions.
